description: Markup-guided image edits with GPT Image 2.6 on varg: draw circles, boxes, arrows and short notes on a transparent PNG the same size as the source (scripts/markup.py turns a JSON list of shapes into that PNG, a preview and the prompt lines), upload it, then edit with provider_options.fal.markup_image_url and a prompt written per colour ("Red circle: … Blue circle: … Change nothing outside the marks."). Includes the measured example (two changes, the rest of the frame kept), how to check what changed, and when to use a black-and-white mask_url instead. Use when someone wants to change one or several specific spots in an image, says "circle it", "only change this part", "fix this word", "add a hat here", or an edit keeps changing things it should not. Not for whole-image restyles (gpt-image-2-6 recipes), animation (gpt-image-gif) or video edits (varg-ai).
